svg.text: KNOB SUPPORT - WHEELS, COLLARS AND ECCENTRIC BUSHES
the 60 (Cadrane) — desk dial
DRAWING
REV
SCALE
AS SHOWN
DATE
UNITS
mm

Projected from docs/v15/the60_v15_assembly.step by hidden-line projection, with dimension text written from docs/v15/the60_v15/src/params.py. No hand drafting. The knob is drawn on its turned profile: the knurl is on the part but is not drawn.
MODELLED, NOT MADE — no v15 part has been produced. Dimensions are model values, not inspection results. Bodies tagged ENVELOPE or ASSUMED in the model are drawn as envelopes, not as the real part.
SECTION A-A scale 1.75 : 1
Right half, on the 30 deg - 210 deg axis, through the wheel at 30 deg. Hatching is cut material; plain lines are behind the cut.
CL
r 77.83 wheel axis
r 83.20 bore
r 87.70 knob
NOTES
V-groove in the bore: root r 84.50, 90 deg included, 1.30 deep, 0.60 flat
at the root so contact is on the flanks only. z 19.9 - 23.1. The bore is
dia 166 and smooth elsewhere: v15 moved the code ring off the bore into
the crown's underside, so nothing else breaks the turned surface.
623ZZ bearing 3 x 10 x 4 pressed into a turned dia 13.20 V-collar. Axis r
77.83, z 19.5 - 23.5. Three off, at 30 deg / 150 deg / 270 deg.
Eccentric bush: a dia 5.00 shank in the post carrying a dia 2.96 wheel pin
offset 0.90 from it, under a dia 7.00 flange 0.60 thick, with a 2 mm hex
socket underneath. Pin inward, the wheel sits at r 76.03 - 0.57 clear
inside the bore - and the knob drops on; half a turn from below seats it
and sets the preload.
v15 inverted the structure. There is no ledge: the seat flange (z 24.0 -
26.0) is the datum face, and the wheel posts hang below it, dia 8.00 with
a dia 5.10 bush bore, top face z 18.9. The flange's top face is the
display's seat and prints flat on the bed. Plate screws from below at 160
deg / 240 deg / 320 deg.
The wheels carry the knob's weight and its lift-off load. Nothing else
supports it: the drive band is a friction contact on the same bore, and
the halo, the code ring and the display all clear the knob.
V-on-V locates the knob radially and axially at once and takes the lift-off
load, so the knob cannot be pulled off the device.
Knob 19.5 tall: 57 % of the 34.4 body height, 54 % of the 35.9 including the pad.
DETAIL X - GROOVE AND COLLAR 8 : 1
Notchiness three times a turn means the collars are bottoming on the
0.60 root flat. Bore-to-groove concentricity within 0.05 total: runout
modulates the wheel preload, and the wheels are what hold the knob.
PLAN - HORIZONTAL SECTION AT z 21.5 scale 0.56 : 1
30 deg
150 deg
270 deg
0 deg USB-C
Dashed rectangle: the display panel, 136.5 x 132.2, centre 2.1 in -x - its real outline from the model, above this cut.
v15 clears the panel by height, not by azimuth: the panel sits on the seat flange at z 26.0, above the posts, whose tops are at z 18.9. The posts' inner faces are at r 72.93.
The wheels stay at 30 deg / 150 deg / 270 deg so the encoder tower at 310 deg and the port slot at 0 deg have the gaps between them. Encoder on D02.
0.90 ecc
dia 8.00 post
DETAIL Y - BUSH AND POST 7 : 1
Bush flange 0.60 thick sits on the post's underside at z 18.9.
Printed pin is the known weak point - brass with an
M2 grub screw in production.
WHEEL AND BUSH - ISOMETRIC 3.4 : 1
V-collar over the 623ZZ, on the eccentric bush,
as assembled. Hidden edges dashed.
